name: ts-admin-basic-info-service
description: This service provides CRUD APIs to manage basic information for administrator, include contacts information, station information, train information, config information and price information.

name: ts-admin-order-service
description: This service provide CRUD APIs about order management for administrator.

name: ts-admin-route-service
description: This service provide APIs to manage route. The route entity include distances, stations, start station and end station.

name: ts-admin-travel-service
description: This service provide APIs to manage teavel. The travel entity include the type of train, the trip and the start and end time.

name: ts-admin-user-service
description: This service provide APIs to manage users, include get user information, add user, modify user information and delete a user.

name: ts-assurance-service
description: This service provide APIs to manage and buy assurance, include many get APIs to get assurance information by different parameter, delete APIs to cancel assurance order and PATCH API to modify assurance order.

name: ts-auth-service
description: This service provide APIs to manage user informations and auth operation.

name: ts-basic-service
description: This service provide APIs to query some basic information: basic travel information and basic station information.

name: ts-cancel-service
description: This service provide APIs to calculate refund and cancel ticket.

name: ts-config-service
description: This service provide APIs to manage configs, include query, create, update and delete.

name: ts-consign-price-service
description: This service provide APIs to calculate consign price and manage consign config.

name: ts-consign-service
description: This service provide APIs to create, update and query consign order.

name: ts-contacts-service
description: This service provide APIs to get all contacts, create contacts, create contacts in admin, delete contact, modify contact's information, query contacts by accountId adn query contacts by contactId.

name: ts-execute-service
description: This service provide ticket collection and execute related API.

name: ts-food-service
description: This service provide APIs to CRUD foodOrders, get all food order and get all foods in an interval.

name: ts-inside-payment-service
description: This service provide APIs to do inside payment, query money, top up money into account, query money info, create account.

name: ts-notification-service
description: This service provide API to send email when preserve success, order create success, update order success and cancel notification success.

name: ts-order-other-service
description: This service provide API to manage other order(means order which train's ID is not start with G or D)

name: ts-order-service
description: This service provide API to manage order(means order which train's ID IS start with G

name: ts-payment-service
description: This service provide API to create payment, top up money and query payment

name: ts-preserve-other-service
description: This service provide API to preserve other train's ticket.

name: ts-preserve-service
description: This service provide API to preserve train's ticket.

name: ts-price-service
description: This service provide API to calculate tickets' price and manage price configs.

name: ts-rebook-service
description: This service provide Train ticket rescheduling API and differential payment API.

name: ts-route-plan-service
description: This service provide APIs to get cheapest Route, quickest Route and min Stop Stations Route.

name: ts-route-service
description: This service provide APIs to CRUD route informations.

name: ts-seat-service
description: This service provide APIs to allocate seats for users and query left tickets in an interval.

name: ts-security-service
description: This service provide APIs to manage security config files, includes add, delete, query, modify config file and check account id.

name: ts-station-food-service
description: This service provide APIs to CRUD station food.

name: ts-station-service
description: This service provide APIs to CRUD station information, and it also provide APIs to get station name by id and get station id by name.

name: ts-ticket-office-service
description: This service provide APIs to get ticket office information and manage ticket office information.

name: ts-train-food-service
description: This service provide APIs to CRUD train food.

name: ts-train-service
description: This service provide APIs to manage train information, includes create train entity, update train information, get train's information and delete trains information.

name: ts-travel-plan-service
description: This service provide APIs to get travel plan, includes cheapest travel plan, quickest travel plan, min station travel plan.

name: ts-travel-service
description: This service provide APIs to manage high speed train's trip.

name: ts-travel2-service
description: This service provide APIs to manage normal train's trip.

name: ts-ui-dashboard
description: This repository provide all the UI interface to interact with the system.

description: This service provide APIs to manage user information, includes register user, get user by username, get user by userId, and allow administrator to delete a user.

name: ts-verification-code-service
description: This service provide APIs to generate verification code pictures and verify code which user send.

name: ts-voucher-service
description: This service provide APIs to generate the reimbursement voucher based on the order id.
